query: AMD Q2 2026 Data Center revenue split Instinct EPYC
normalized: 2026 amd center data epyc instinct q2 revenue split

output.content:
AMD did not disclose a dollar revenue split between Instinct accelerators and EPYC server CPUs for Q2 2026; it reported them together within its Data Center segment. [[1]] 

Data Center revenue was **$6.718 billion** in Q2 2026, up **107% year over year**, with AMD attributing the performance to strong demand for both EPYC processors and Instinct GPUs. [[1]] 

The available qualitative detail is that EPYC sales increased by **more than 70% year over year**, while Instinct sales **more than doubled year over year**, but neither figure was quantified in dollars; therefore, an Instinct-versus-EPYC revenue allocation cannot be reliably calculated from AMD’s reported results. [[2]]
